description: This file contains shell script code for testing the wildmatch pattern matching functionality. It defines various test functions and executes a series of unit tests to verify the correctness of pattern matching including wildcards, path matching, case sensitivity, character classes, recursion, and other features.

methods.name: should_create_test_file
methods.description: Decides whether a test file should be created based on filename validity and platform-specific constraints.

methods.name: match_with_function
methods.description: Performs pattern matching test using a specified matching function and verifies the result against expectation.

methods.name: match_with_ls_files
methods.description: Performs pattern matching test via 'git ls-files' command and compares output with expected results.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Coordinates multiple pattern matching tests, setting up test environment, executing 'wildmatch' with different options, and verifying results.
